summary: Diageo plc furnished a Form 6-K on 13 October 2026 announcing publication of restated historical regional financial results for fiscal years ended 30 June 2025 and 30 June 2026. The restatement realigns external reporting with Diageo's new market and regional operating framework effective fiscal 27, disclosed via press release on the investors section of diageo.com. No transaction, stakeholder solicitation, or strategic event is involved; this is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure. No board recommendation, advisor, mechanics, or deal terms. Watch for segment-level recasts affecting consensus estimates and comparability into fiscal 27.
